svg.title: Abdelhmeed Elshorbagy: Server Administrator at Amwag Travel
svg.desc: A matte black circuit board. The main processor U1 is decapped to show its silicon die, etched with the name Abdelhmeed Elshorbagy and the words Creative engineer. Its pins break out to: Server Administrator at Amwag Travel; IT Help Desk; Computer Science & AI student, Minya National University; Minya, Egypt; Bilingual product builder (Arabic / English); Cybersecurity enthusiast; Founder of DÖSE, an Egyptian niche fragrance house; On GitHub since 2020. last push yesterday.
